              p.output K_L < p.depreciation * K_L ∧
                have prices := Aiyagari1994.M09A3.lowerOriginalPrices m p hp b hb r_L;
                let household := Aiyagari1994.M09A3.lowerHousehold m p hp b hb r_L;
                have hbetaR := ⋯;
                prices.debtLimit = b ∧
                  0 < 1 + ↑r_L ∧
                    household.beta * household.prices.grossReturn < 1 ∧
                      Aiyagari1994.stationaryAssetSupply household prices.debtLimit
                          (Aiyagari1994.M06C.stationaryLaw household hsmooth hcurvature hnd hbetaR) <
                        K_L

  (hsmooth : Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth m.utility) (hcurvature : Aiyagari1994.UtilityCurvature m.utility)
  (hnd : Aiyagari1994.IncomeNondegenerate m.income) (b w : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hw : 0 < w) :
  (∀ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m),
      Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd b w hb hw r ≥
        Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteCertaintySupply m b w hb hw r) ∧
    (∀ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m),
        Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd w hw r ≥
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalCertaintySupply m w hw r) ∧
      (∀ᶠ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m) in
          Filter.comap (fun (x : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m) => ↑x)
            (nhds (Aiyagari1994.M09C2.criticalRate m)),
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd b w hb hw r >
            Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteCertaintySupply m b w hb hw r) ∧
        ∀ᶠ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m) in
          Filter.comap (fun (x : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m) => ↑x)
            (nhds (Aiyagari1994.M09C2.criticalRate m)),
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd w hw r >
            Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalCertaintySupply m w hw r
